ENormedAddCommSubMonoid.source:
/-- An enormed monoid is an additive monoid endowed with a continuous enorm.
Note: not sure if this is the "right" class to add to Mathlib. -/
class ENormedAddCommSubMonoid (E : Type*) [TopologicalSpace E] extends ENormedAddCommMonoid E, Sub E where
  sub_add_cancel_of_enorm_le : ∀ ⦃x y : E⦄, ‖y‖ₑ ≤ ‖x‖ₑ → x - y + y = x
  add_right_cancel_of_enorm_lt_top : ∀ ⦃x : E⦄, ‖x‖ₑ < ⊤ → ∀ {y z : E}, y + x = z + x → y = z
  esub_self : ∀ x : E, x - x = 0

ENNReal.toReal_Icc_eq_Icc.source:
lemma ENNReal.toReal_Icc_eq_Icc {a b : ℝ≥0∞} (ha : a ≠ ∞) (hb : b ≠ ∞) :
    ENNReal.toReal '' Set.Icc a b = Set.Icc a.toReal b.toReal := by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_image, mem_Icc]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hy₁, hy₂⟩, hxy⟩

MeasureTheory.NoAtoms'.PFun.Dom_insert.source:
@[simp]
theorem PFun.Dom_insert {β : Type*} {f : α →. β} {a : α} {b : β} :
    (PFun.insert f a b).Dom = f.Dom.insert a := by
  unfold PFun.insert PFun.Dom Set.insert
  ext x
  simp only [Part.coe_some, mem_ofPred_eq]

I1_measurableSet.source:
lemma I1_measurableSet {k : ℤ} (hk : -S ≤ k) (y : Yk X k) : MeasurableSet (I1 hk y) := by
    by_cases hk_s : k = -S
    · rw [I1, dite_eq_left hk_s]
      exact measurableSet_ball
    · let hk'' : -S < k := lt_of_le_of_ne hk fun a_1 ↦ hk_s (id a_1.symm)
      have h1: 0 ≤ S + (k - 1) := by linarith

I2_measurableSet.source:
lemma I2_measurableSet {k : ℤ} (hk : -S ≤ k) (y : Yk X k) : MeasurableSet (I2 hk y) := by
    by_cases hk_s : k = -S
    · rw [I2, dite_eq_left hk_s]
      exact measurableSet_ball
    · let hk'' : -S < k := lt_of_le_of_ne hk fun a_1 ↦ hk_s (id a_1.symm)
      rw [I2, dite_eq_right hk_s]

Xk_measurableSet.source:
lemma Xk_measurableSet {k : ℤ} (hk : -S ≤ k) : MeasurableSet (Xk hk) := by
    rw [Xk]
    let := (Yk_countable X k).to_subtype
    apply MeasurableSet.iUnion fun b ↦ I1_measurableSet hk b
  termination_by (3 * (S+k).toNat + 1, 0)
